properties.name: 508 White Steppe Way
properties.note: Updated 4-bed, 2.5-bath townhome in the Saddle Creek community of Georgetown with quartz counters, stainless appliances, a built-in wine fridge and an open downstairs layout. Backs to a park/greenbelt with no rear neighbors. Refrigerator included; washer/dryer available for an extra fee.

details.Laundry: Laundry room; washer & dryer can be provided for an additional fee
details.Pets: Cats and dogs, small (under 20 lbs), max 2 — $250 deposit per pet; $25/mo per pet
details.Tenant pays: Electricity, Gas, Water, Sewer, Trash, Internet, Cable TV, Phone, Pest control, Renters insurance
details.Appliances: Refrigerator, Built-in range/oven, Dishwasher, Disposal, Microwave, Built-in wine fridge, Tankless water heater
details.Assigned schools: James E Mitchell, Wagner, East View
details.Area: Close to I-35, Georgetown outlet mall, dining and IKEA (Round Rock).

features: Open floor plan downstairs - kitchen overlooks dining/family room
Primary suite with his & hers closets, walk-in shower and large vanity
Backs to park/greenbelt - no rear neighbors

details.Laundry: In hall - washer hookup and electric dryer hookup (tenant supplies washer/dryer)
details.Pets: Cats and dogs, small (under 20 lbs), max 2 — $250 deposit per pet
details.Tenant pays: Electricity, Gas, Water, Sewer, Trash, Internet, Phone, Pest control, Renters insurance

features: Balconies on both sides of the unit
Primary bedroom with jetted (Jacuzzi) tub, separate shower and walk-in closet
Ceiling fans in living room and all bedrooms

details.Pets: Cats and dogs, small (under 20 lbs), max 2 — $300 deposit per pet; $25/mo per pet
details.Tenant pays: Electricity, Gas, Internet/cable, Renters insurance, Water (billed through HOA based on usage - per public remarks)
details.Appliances: Refrigerator, Dishwasher, Microwave, Stainless steel appliances, Stacked washer/dryer (per MLS field; remarks say W/D available for a fee)
details.Area: Central West Austin off Bee Caves Rd with quick access to Loop 360 and MoPac. Zoned to Eanes ISD.

features: Open floor plan with dedicated dining and living areas
Primary bedroom with walk-in closet, stand-alone shower and direct back-yard access
Ceiling fans in bedrooms and living areas
